claim: Provide an evidence-append front door: a sanctioned entry point (a Mutation type plus a mix task) for appending a dated evidence entry to an existing belief. Evidence is the one sanctioned in-place growth point on an immutable node, yet it is the only common write without tooling - every append today is an ad-hoc scripted Store write.

evidence.detail: Three specimens in one session (postscript 8): the b501 link-back replay, the b049 dep re-point (whose Mutation clauses append evidence internally but expose no evidence-only type), and the close's own four appends (b519, b500, and the b507 retro-pairs on b521/b062) - each a hand-rolled script against CB.Belief.Store. Preflight 2026-06-11: backlog tag-family overlap only; no semantic conflict.

Third and fourth instances in one session (the b515 discharge thread): the discharge rationale append on b515 and this close's b507 retro-pairs both required raw CB.Belief.Store scripts because no sanctioned append entry point exists. Now the most-reproved gap on the desk.

Fifth and sixth specimens (the b511 discharge close), plus a new failure mode the front door would also close: the b511 discharge-evidence append and the t0013 status flip both went through raw python against the graph files, and the whole-file re-dump used json.dumps defaults (ensure_ascii=true), unicode-escaping every non-ascii character in beliefs.json - caught only by diff inspection and re-dumped clean. A sanctioned append entry point would pin serialization along with the write. This close's own appends (this entry and b519's third specimen) ran through CB.Belief.Store directly - still a hand-rolled script, specimens seven and eight by the same count.

Discharged 2026-06-12 (materialized t0014): the append-evidence Mutation clause and the mix cb.evidence front door landed with clause and validator tests (308 passing, schema verify 20/20). The entry rides Belief.to_map key ordering and Store.write atomic serialization, so the encoder drift evidence 3 recorded cannot recur through this path - verified end-to-end on a temp graph copy before the live run. This entry is the front door appending its own discharge evidence: first production run.

First-production-run catch, the b530 close: the front door's date default drifted from the system's convention - Mutation.resolve_date defaulted to Date.utc_today() while every other writer stamps CB.today() (local), so two appends run past midnight UTC landed dated 2026-06-13 on a 2026-06-12 ceremony. Fixed inline (resolve_date now stamps CB.today()); the two misstamped dates repaired surgically in the graph, the repair recorded in the chronicle. Date semantics of this front door are now: local date, same as the materializer.

todos.action: Provide the evidence-append front door: append-evidence Mutation type in CB.Belief.Mutation (explicit artifact/date with session-slug and today fallbacks) plus the mix cb.evidence task - bare or namespaced id resolution, detail/artifact/date validation, dry-run default, --beliefs collection override, serialization pinned by Belief.to_map key order and Store.write atomic encoding
todos.notes: Discharged in the executing session itself. End-to-end verified on a temp graph copy: an append containing non-ascii produced a diff of exactly the five new entry lines, byte-identical elsewhere, no unicode escapes - the ensure_ascii encoder-drift failure mode from evidence 3 closed by construction. This materialization's own discharge evidence was appended via mix cb.evidence, the front door's first production run.
